en.title: @deepseek-ai/dsh-101-core
en.summary: DSH 101 corpus model, search index, and curation overlay merge — a pure library (no Cordis plugin) consumed by the dsh-101 profile plugins.
en.body:
# @deepseek-ai/dsh-101-core

DSH 101 corpus model, search index, and curation overlay merge — a pure
library (no Cordis plugin) consumed by the dsh-101 profile plugins.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

## Model Experience

### Model view

#### What the model sees

The corpus index, search result projection, and curation overlay are pure data consumed by host plugins via `ctx.dsh101`; this package registers no prompt sections or tool schemas of its own.

#### Token effect

None: corpus parsing, search indexing, and curation merging run host-side with no model input.

#### KV Cache effect

None: no request shaping; search and curation outputs are stable per corpus revision.

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

The corpus is the single source of truth for the DSH 101 reader: a versioned
JSON index (`schemaVersion`, `dshVersion`, `revision`, `modules`,
`documents`) where document ids are stable, derived from
repository-relative paths. The user curation overlay carries only module
ordering, summaries, and redirects — never document bodies.

- `parseCorpusIndex` / `parseCurationFile`: schema validation with loud
  `CorpusValidationError`s; a wrong schema version, missing revision, or
  unknown document id in an overlay is a hard failure, never a silent skip.
- `mergeCuration`: pure overlay application (module order, module
  reassignment, summary overrides) returning a new corpus; no overlay means
  the corpus is returned unchanged.
- `buildSearchIndex` / `searchCorpus`: bounded in-memory index over title,
  summary, headings, and section previews, with CJK-aware tokenization,
  title/heading weighting, and a half-token match threshold. Results carry
  section anchors and excerpts for citation cards.
- `serializeCuration`: stable-key JSON serialization for reproducible,
  diffable overlay files.

- The index embeds section previews (≤600 chars); full bodies are loaded on
  demand from per-document files by the host plugin. Long documents are
  truncated in the corpus at 60 KB (a marker comment is appended).
- Search is substring-based over tokens; no stemming, synonyms, or
  ranking beyond token coverage and title/heading weighting.
- CJK queries tokenize as contiguous character runs; very long CJK phrases
  may under-match until the query is shortened.

zh.title: @deepseek-ai/dsh-101-core
zh.summary: DSH 101 语料模型、搜索索引与策展覆盖层合并 —— 一个纯库（无 Cordis 插件），由 dsh-101 profile 插件消费。
zh.body:
# @deepseek-ai/dsh-101-core

DSH 101 语料模型、搜索索引与策展覆盖层合并 —— 一个纯库（无 Cordis 插件），由 dsh-101 profile 插件消费。

[English](README.md) | 中文

## 模型体验

### 模型视图

#### 模型看到什么

语料索引、搜索结果投影与策展覆盖层都是被 host 插件通过 `ctx.dsh101` 消费的纯数据；本包自身不注册任何提示词段或工具 schema。

#### Token 影响

无：语料解析、搜索索引与策展合并都在 host 侧运行，不消耗模型输入。

#### KV 缓存影响

无：无请求整形；搜索与策展输出按语料 revision 稳定。

## 已知限制与后续工作

语料是 DSH 101 阅读器的唯一事实来源：带版本的 JSON 索引（`schemaVersion`、`dshVersion`、`revision`、`modules`、`documents`），文档 id 稳定、由仓库相对路径推导。用户策展覆盖层只携带模块顺序、摘要和重定向——绝不携带文档正文。

- `parseCorpusIndex` / `parseCurationFile`：schema 校验，失败时抛出明确的 `CorpusValidationError`；错误的 schema 版本、缺失 revision 或覆盖层引用未知文档 id 都是硬失败，绝不静默跳过。
- `mergeCuration`：纯覆盖层应用（模块顺序、模块重新归属、摘要覆盖）返回新语料；无覆盖层时原样返回语料。
- `buildSearchIndex` / `searchCorpus`：基于标题、摘要、章节标题和章节预览的有界内存索引，支持 CJK 分词、标题/章节加权和半 token 匹配阈值。结果携带章节锚点和摘录，供引用卡片使用。
- `serializeCuration`：稳定键序的 JSON 序列化，保证可复现、可 diff 的覆盖层文件。

- 索引内嵌章节预览（≤600 字符）；完整正文由 host 插件按需从逐文档文件加载。长文档在语料中被截断到 60 KB（追加标记注释）。
- 搜索是基于 token 的子串匹配；没有词干、同义词或超越 token 覆盖率和标题/章节加权的排序。
- CJK 查询按连续字符段分词；很长的 CJK 短语可能匹配不足，需要缩短查询。
